$comment: Computed-style contract for every antd class override in packages/web-ui/src/**/*.less. Regenerate after an antd upgrade and diff against this file: a change to a computed value, or to resolvedPath, means an override stopped winning or moved in the DOM. Keys are source .less file -> compiled CSS selector -> observed state.

meta.harness: packages/web-ui/test/ui-test gallery via `pnpm --filter @pinnacle0/web-ui run start`; global.less imported at the gallery entry so the published cascade is faithful
meta.method: getComputedStyle on the first element matching each compiled selector; longhands only; CSS transitions finished before measuring
caveats: matchCount is crawl-order dependent for AdminApp shell selectors: the gallery's navigator bar accumulates one tab per visited route, so counts on .navigator-bar / sider / menu selectors reflect how many routes were visited before the observation, not antd. Compare matchCount only across runs that used the same routeOrder and the same state sequence.
Observations are the FIRST match per (selector, state) in the documented route order, not the maximum.
Layout-dependent values (heights, widths in px) depend on the capture viewport; treat small px deltas as harness noise unless the declared property is itself a length.
state=load values come from the route crawl; interaction states were captured in the same browser session immediately afterwards.
meta.routeOrderNote: Route crawl order: '/' then NavigationData order, skipping /admin/render-error (it throws by design); /admin/separate-tab-detail visited as /88.
